title: Acme Mobile
subtitle: Motion and interaction notes
intro: The two things in this app that a screenshot cannot carry: a crash on a gesture, and the one interaction that genuinely works.

meta.data: Synthetic data throughout. No real user data appears in any clip.

clips.title: Results map to list view terminates the app
clips.watch: The map pans normally. One tap on the list toggle and the app is gone, straight to the home screen. No error screen, no recovery.
clips.detail:
A native crash, not a JavaScript error, so none of the app's own error handling catches it. From the simulator log:

*** Terminating app due to uncaught exception 'NSInternalInconsistencyException'

Reproduced twice; after each one the process list confirmed the app was gone.
clips.caveat: Observed on a debug simulator build. Confirm on a release build before treating it as a shipping defect, and treat it as one until that check is clean.

clips.title: Estimate builder, live total
clips.watch: Toggling items in and out. The total and the priced-count update together, immediately, with no spinner.
clips.detail: The recalculation is local, so it feels instant rather than networked, and unpriced items keep showing a dash rather than dropping to zero.

footer: Recorded with the simulator's own recorder and transcoded to H.264 at 402px wide. Synthetic data throughout.
